title: Associated Banc-Corp Increases Prime Rate
summary: Associated Banc-Corp (NYSE: ASB), the holding company for Associated Bank, N.A., announced today it has increased the bank's prime rate to 7.00 percent from 6.75 percent, effective September 17, 2026.
